summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.97% of shares outstanding) authorized for acquisition up to ¥1,000M via open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange; execution window Jun 9 – Dec 8, 2026. Stated reason: improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: LEC Inc. announced on June 8, 2026 a treasury stock acquisition program authorized by board resolution. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 shares (2.97% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) with an upper limit of ¥1,000M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from June 9 to December 8, 2026. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and implement flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. As of March 31, 2026, the company held 4,558,192 treasury shares against 33,607,148 shares outstanding.
